workouts.summary: Rock defenders with between-the-legs rhythm, snap the ball back on crossovers, then chain five moves at game speed with your eyes up.

drills.name: Rocker Between-the-Legs
drills.summary: Rock your weight front to back and push the ball through your legs on time.
steps: Start in a staggered stance with your right foot forward.
Rock your weight forward, then back, as you dribble through your legs.
Keep the ball below your knees the whole time.
Go 45 seconds, then switch your front foot and repeat.
Finish by adding a hard first step out of every third rep.

drills.name: Snatch-Back Crossovers
drills.summary: Cross over hard, then pull the ball straight back before a defender can reach.
steps: Take two hard dribbles forward at 75% speed.
Cross the ball low and quick to your other hand.
Snatch the ball back toward your back hip with one dribble.
Explode forward again and cross back the other way.
Work the length of the driveway and back, then go to game speed.

drills.name: Five-Move Finish Chains
drills.summary: String five moves together without stopping, then attack the garage line at full speed.
steps: Pick a chain: pound, cross, between, behind, hesitation.
Do the chain standing in place with your eyes on a spot on the garage.
Add a hard drive of three dribbles after the last move.
Walk back and repeat, starting with your weak hand.
Make up a new chain each minute and go full speed.

workouts.summary: Study film to count fast-break numbers, see how drives create kick-out shots, and watch the ball swing to an open shooter.

drills.name: Film: Count the Break
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Count the attackers and defenders on every fast break and judge the guard's choice.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film and watch transition after steals and long rebounds.
Pause as the ball crosses half court and count: 2-on-1, 3-on-2 or even.
Say out loud what the ball handler should do: attack, pass or pull it out.
Play it and see if they made the right call.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

drills.name: Film: Drive and Kick Spacing
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Watch where shooters move when a teammate drives to the rim.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film and watch the players without the ball on every drive.
Pause when the driver reaches the paint.
Say where each shooter went: corner, wing or slot.
Point to the defender who left their player to help.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

drills.name: Film: Swing-Swing Ball Movement
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: See how quick passes around the arc beat a defense that is out of position.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film and watch every possession with two or more quick passes.
Pause after each pass and say which defender is late.
Count how many passes it took to get an open shot.
Notice who held the ball too long and killed the advantage.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

workouts.summary: Finish off the glass with your weak hand, add soft scoops and spin-backs, and attack the rim out of a crossover.

drills.name: Weak-Hand Wing Finishes
drills.summary: Score off the glass from the wing using only your weak hand.
steps: Start on the wing on your weak-hand side.
Take one hard dribble with your weak hand and step into a two-step finish.
Lay it high off the top corner of the box.
Rebound, go back out and repeat.
After 90 seconds, switch to the other wing using that weak hand on the reverse side.

drills.name: Underhand Scoop Finishes
drills.summary: Use a soft underhand scoop to finish around a big defender's reach.
steps: Start at the top of the key.
Drive hard at the rim with two dribbles.
Gather early and extend the ball low, palm up.
Flip it softly off the glass before the shot-blocker arrives.
Alternate sides of the rim each rep.

drills.name: Crossover Rim Attacks
drills.summary: Beat an imaginary defender with a crossover and get downhill to the rim.
steps: Start at the three-point line on the wing.
Jab toward one side, then cross over low to the other hand.
Take a long first step past your imaginary defender.
Get to the rim in two dribbles or less and finish.
Alternate wings and directions each rep.

drills.name: Spin-Back Lane Finishes
drills.summary: Spin off a defender in the lane and finish with either hand at game speed.
steps: Drive from the elbow toward the block.
Plant your inside foot and spin back toward the middle, keeping the ball tight.
Finish with the hand farthest from the defender.
Work both elbows and both spin directions.
Go game speed once the spin is clean.

workouts.summary: Build shot rhythm with a dip-and-lift mid-range, catch threes off a self-pass, then pull up out of a hang dribble.

drills.name: Dip-and-Lift Mid-Range
drills.summary: Dip the ball to your hip on the catch and lift it into one smooth shot.
steps: Start at the right elbow with the ball in your hands.
Dip the ball to your shooting hip as you bend your knees.
Lift the ball and shoot in one motion, holding your follow-through.
Make 5, then move to the free-throw line and the left elbow.
Keep rotating spots until time is up.

drills.name: Spin-Pass Catch Threes
drills.summary: Toss a spin pass to yourself and catch it ready to shoot a three.
steps: Stand a step inside the arc on the wing.
Spin the ball out in front so it bounces back to you.
Hop into the catch with your feet set and hands ready.
Shoot the three with your feet under your shoulders.
Rotate corner, wing and top on both sides.

drills.name: Hang Dribble Pull-Ups
drills.summary: Hang the dribble to freeze the defender, then rise up for a pull-up jumper.
steps: Start at half court and push the ball at game speed.
At the three-point line, hang the dribble and lift your eyes to the rim.
Take one hard dribble to the elbow and stop on balance.
Rise straight up and shoot.
Alternate going left and right each rep.

workouts.summary: Sharpen your ready stance, turn the ball handler on every dribble, then sprint out and stop the drive with a partner.

drills.name: Sprint-Chop Ready Stances
drills.summary: Sprint to a cone, chop your feet and land in a perfect stance.
steps: Set two cones about 5 big steps apart.
Sprint from one cone to the other.
Chop your feet short and fast for the last two steps.
Land in stance: wide feet, low hips, hands active.
Hold for two seconds, then sprint back.

drills.name: Dribbler Turn Battles
drills.summary: Stay in front of a dribbler and make them change direction as many times as you can.
steps: Your partner dribbles slowly from baseline toward half court inside the lane width.
Slide and beat them to their spot to force a turn.
Keep your chest in front of the ball and do not reach.
Count how many times you turn them by half court.
Switch roles each trip and speed it up after two rounds.

drills.name: Sprint-Close Contain Duels
drills.summary: Sprint at a shooter, break down under control, then stop their drive.
steps: Start under the rim with the ball. Your partner waits on the wing.
Pass to your partner and sprint at them.
Chop your feet with a hand high to take away the shot.
Your partner drives and you slide to stop them in three dribbles.
Switch roles every rep and play to 5 stops.

workouts.summary: Build your engine with tempo strides, cone sprints and slide intervals, then finish with full-speed fast-break layups on short rest.

drills.name: Quarter-Court Tempo Strides
drills.summary: Stride the court at building speeds to get your engine running.
steps: Start on the baseline.
Jog to the free-throw line, run to half court, then sprint to the far baseline.
Walk back along the sideline.
Repeat until time is up, sprinting a little harder each trip.

drills.name: Cone Star Sprints
drills.summary: Sprint out and back to cones in a star shape around you.
steps: Place one cone in the middle and four cones about 5 steps away in a star.
Sprint from the middle to a cone and touch it.
Backpedal to the middle, then go to the next cone.
Do all four cones, rest 15 seconds and go again.

drills.name: Lane Slide Intervals
drills.summary: Slide lane line to lane line in stance for short, hard bursts.
steps: Get in stance on one lane line.
Slide to the other lane line and touch it with your hand.
Slide back without standing up.
Go 20 seconds hard, rest 10 seconds, repeat until time is up.

drills.name: Fast-Break Finish Repeats
drills.summary: Push the ball coast to coast at full speed and finish, with almost no rest.
steps: Start on the baseline with the ball.
Speed dribble the full court and finish with a layup.
Grab the ball and speed dribble back for a layup on the other end.
Rest 15 seconds after each round trip.
Alternate your finishing hand each layup.

beginner.summary: This week we control the ball at three heights, then add simple crossovers and between-the-legs moves while walking with eyes up.

drills.name: Knee-to-Hip Dribble Heights
drills.summary: Control the ball low, then high, with each hand.
steps: Stand in an athletic stance with the ball in your right hand.
Dribble at knee height for 10 hard dribbles.
Switch to hip height for 10 dribbles.
Repeat with your left hand.
Keep your eyes on the garage or the rim the whole time.

drills.name: Driveway Crossover Lines
drills.summary: Walk the length of the driveway with clean, low crossovers.
steps: Start at one end of the driveway.
Walk forward and cross the ball from hand to hand.
Keep each crossover below your knees.
Turn at the end and walk back the same way.
Speed up a little once it feels easy.

drills.name: Between-Legs Walk Series
drills.summary: Step and dribble between your legs with both hands while walking.
steps: Step forward with your left foot.
Bounce the ball between your legs from right hand to left.
Step with your right foot and go back left to right.
Walk to the end of the driveway and back.
Stop and reset if you lose the ball.

beginner.summary: This week you study how a point guard brings the ball up and how they call the play.

drills.name: Film: Bringing It Up
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Watch one point guard bring the ball up the floor against pressure.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film and follow only the point guard.
Watch each time they bring the ball past half court.
Pause when a defender picks them up and say which hand they dribble with.
Notice if they speed up, slow down or pass ahead.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

drills.name: Film: Point Guard's Calls
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Watch how the point guard tells the team what to run.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film and watch the point guard after they cross half court.
Look for hand signals, pointing or yelling to teammates.
Pause after each call and say what the team does next.
Count how many times they call something.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

beginner.summary: This week we build soft touch close to the rim, then add one and two dribbles to finish with both hands.

drills.name: Right-Left Bank Spots
drills.summary: Bank in short layups off the square with the correct hand.
steps: Stand one big step from the rim on the right side.
Step and lay it off the top corner of the square with your right hand.
Get your rebound and move to the left side.
Finish with your left hand off the glass.
Keep alternating sides until time runs out.

drills.name: One-Dribble Lane Layups
drills.summary: Take one strong dribble from the lane line and finish.
steps: Start at the block on the right side, two steps out.
Take one dribble toward the rim with your right hand.
Go right foot, left foot, and finish with your right hand.
Rebound and repeat from the left side with your left hand.
Make 5 from each side, then keep going.

drills.name: Wing Rip-and-Go Layups
drills.summary: Rip the ball from the wing and drive straight to a layup.
steps: Start on the right wing in triple threat.
Rip the ball low across your body.
Drive with your right hand and take two dribbles to the rim.
Finish with your right hand off the glass.
Repeat on the left wing with your left hand.

beginner.summary: This week we start close with bank shots, then catch on a self-toss, then shoot off two dribbles.

drills.name: Short Bank Shot Series
drills.summary: Use the backboard from short angles to groove your form.
steps: Stand on the right block, a few feet from the rim.
Shoot off the top corner of the square.
Hold your follow-through until the ball lands.
Move to the left block and repeat.
Make 5 from each side, then step back one step.

drills.name: Self-Toss Catch Jumpers
drills.summary: Spin the ball out, catch on balance and shoot.
steps: Stand at the free-throw line facing the rim.
Toss the ball a few feet in front of you with backspin.
Hop to it and catch with both feet landing together.
Rise straight up and shoot.
Rebound and repeat from both elbows.

drills.name: Two-Dribble Middle Jumpers
drills.summary: Take two controlled dribbles and stop on balance to shoot.
steps: Start on the right wing just inside the three-point line.
Take two dribbles toward the middle with your right hand.
Stop on two feet with your shoulders square.
Shoot and hold your follow-through.
Repeat from the left wing dribbling with your left hand.

beginner.summary: This week we lock in a good stance, slide back under control, then guard a partner at a slow speed.

drills.name: Stance Freeze Checks
drills.summary: Hold a strong defensive stance and check each body part.
steps: Get in stance: feet wide, knees bent, back flat.
Hold for 20 seconds with your hands active.
Stand up and rest for 10 seconds.
Check feet, hips, back and hands each time you drop.
Repeat until time runs out.

drills.name: Lane Line Retreats
drills.summary: Drop-step and slide back down the lane line.
steps: Start at the free-throw line in your stance.
Open your hip and slide back toward the baseline at an angle.
Change direction every three slides.
Reach the baseline, jog back and go again.
Stay low the whole way.

drills.name: Partner Walk-Up Contain
drills.summary: Stay in front of a partner who dribbles at walking speed.
steps: Your partner starts at half court with the ball.
Get in stance an arm's length away.
Partner walks and dribbles side to side toward the baseline.
Slide to keep your nose on the ball.
Switch roles after each trip down the floor.

beginner.summary: This week we build your engine with controlled strides, dribble sprints and slide-then-sprint repeats.

drills.name: Baseline Jog-Stride Repeats
drills.summary: Jog one way, run at 75% back, with short rest.
steps: Start on the baseline.
Jog to the far baseline.
Turn and stride back at 75% speed.
Rest 10 seconds and repeat.
Keep your arms pumping and breathe steady.

drills.name: Two-Cone Dribble Sprints
drills.summary: Dribble hard between two cones and jog back.
steps: Set two cones about 15 steps apart.
Dribble fast to the far cone with your right hand.
Stop, turn and jog back with the ball.
Next rep, use your left hand.
Rest 10 seconds between reps.

drills.name: Slide Then Sprint Repeats
drills.summary: Defensive slide, then turn and sprint like you're getting back.
steps: Set one cone at the elbow and one at half court.
Slide from the lane line to the elbow cone.
Turn and sprint to the half-court cone.
Walk back to the start.
Repeat, sliding the other direction each time.

advanced.summary: Advanced combo handles at game speed, finishing with a tired-legs round to keep your handle sharp late in games.

drills.name: Two-Count Rhythm Changes
drills.summary: Change your dribble rhythm to break a defender's timing.
steps: Pound twice hard with your right hand, then cross on the third beat.
Switch the rhythm: one soft dribble, then one hard push-cross.
Mix slow-slow-fast and fast-fast-slow patterns for 60 seconds each hand.
Finish with 60 seconds of random rhythm changes at full speed.

drills.name: Wrap-Through Counter Sets
drills.summary: Chain between-the-legs into behind-the-back counters on the move.
steps: Attack forward three steps, then go between the legs.
Counter right away with a behind-the-back the other way.
Explode two hard dribbles out of the counter.
Go up and back on the driveway, leading with each hand.

drills.name: Clock-Face Attack Angles
drills.summary: Attack from different angles and pick the right combo for each one.
steps: Stand in the middle and picture a clock around you.
Call a number out loud, then attack that direction with two hard dribbles.
Use a combo move at the end: hesi-cross, in-and-out, or spin.
Retreat dribble back to the middle and call the next number.
Never call the same number twice in a row.

drills.name: Gassed Handle Finisher
drills.summary: Run your best combos while your legs are tired.
steps: Do 20 seconds of fast high-knee dribbling in place.
Right away, do 20 seconds of your best three-move combo moving forward.
Rest 10 seconds, then repeat the round.
Keep the ball below your hip on every move, even when tired.

advanced.summary: Deep film study on beating traps, reading the low man, and spotting coaching adjustments out of timeouts.

drills.name: Film: Blitz Escape Routes
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Study how guards beat a trap on the pick-and-roll.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film and find every pick-and-roll where the defense traps the ball.
Pause when the trap arrives and say the open player out loud: roller, short roll, or weak-side shooter.
Watch how the handler escapes: retreat dribble, split, or early pass.
Note who rotates to cover the roller each time.
Write two takeaways in your notebook about beating a blitz.

drills.name: Film: Tagger and Low Man
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Read several help defenders at once on every drive.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film and focus on the weak-side defenders on drives.
Pause when the ball gets in the paint and name the low man and the next defender up.
Say out loud who is open if each one helps: dunker, corner, or wing.
Rewind and check if the passer made the right read.
Write two takeaways in your notebook about where the open man comes from.

drills.name: Film: Timeout Adjustments
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Scout what each team changes after a timeout in a close game.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film from the last quarter of a close game.
Before each timeout, write what the offense and defense are doing.
After the timeout, pause on the first possession and say what changed.
Note who gets the ball and which matchup each team hunts.
Write two takeaways in your notebook on how you would counter it.

advanced.summary: Advanced finishing with both hands off tempo changes, stride stops and tired legs.

drills.name: Off-Hand Glass Angles
drills.summary: Use the glass with your off hand from tough angles.
steps: Start on the left block and finish with your left hand off the glass.
Move to the short corner, then to a steep angle near the baseline.
Hit three makes at each spot before moving.
Switch sides and use your right hand on the right side.

drills.name: Stride-Stop Counter Finishes
drills.summary: Stop on a 1-2 step in the lane and finish with a counter.
steps: Drive hard from the wing to the block area.
Stop on a 1-2 stride stop with the ball chinned.
Shot fake, then finish with a step-through or a quick go-up.
Alternate wings and alternate the counter each rep.

drills.name: Tempo Shift Lane Attacks
drills.summary: Slow down, then explode past a cone and finish at full speed.
steps: Set a cone at the top of the key and one at the elbow.
Dribble slow to the first cone, then hit a hesi or in-and-out.
Explode past the elbow cone and finish with the outside hand.
Switch sides each rep and change the move every time.

drills.name: Wall-Up Burst Finishes
drills.summary: Sprint, attack and finish under control when you are tired.
steps: Start at half court and sprint-dribble to the rim for a layup.
Rebound, speed-dribble back out to half court.
Attack again with a different finish: reverse, floater or off-hand.
Keep going nonstop and count your makes.
Try to beat your total next week.

advanced.summary: Advanced shooting off movement and combo dribbles, ending with pressure makes on tired legs.

drills.name: Swish-Only Warm Makes
drills.summary: Groove your shot close in, counting only clean swishes.
steps: Start one step in front of the rim and shoot one-handed.
Move back a step after three swishes in a row.
Add your guide hand once you reach the free-throw line.
Rims and banks do not count.

drills.name: Curl-Cut Elbow Catches
drills.summary: Curl tight around a screen and shoot on the catch.
steps: Set a cone on the block as your screen.
Start in the corner and curl tight around the cone to the elbow.
Catch a pass from your rebounder or self-toss and shoot right away.
Alternate elbows and keep your feet ready before the catch.

drills.name: Two-Move Escape Jumpers
drills.summary: Create space with a two-move combo, then rise into a jumper.
steps: Start at the top of the key facing the rim.
Hit a two-move combo: hesi-cross or between-behind.
Rise into a pull-up from the elbow or wing.
Make three at each spot, then move around the arc.

drills.name: Make-Five Pressure Spots
drills.summary: Hit game-pressure threes with sprints between spots.
steps: Pick five spots around the three-point line.
At each spot, shoot five shots and you must make three.
If you miss the target, sprint to half court and back, then retry.
Move to the next spot only after you hit three.

advanced.summary: Advanced on-ball defense: active hands, hip turns, and live contain battles against a partner.

drills.name: Deflection Hand Slides
drills.summary: Slide at game speed with active hands swiping at the ball.
steps: Get in a low stance on the sideline.
Slide across the lane with your lead hand swiping up at an imaginary ball.
Your trail hand stays up to take away the pass.
Go 30 seconds hard, rest 15, repeat.

drills.name: Hip-Turn Run-Outs
drills.summary: Turn your hips and run to cut off a blow-by, then square up again.
steps: Slide three steps toward the sideline.
Open your hips and sprint three steps to beat the driver.
Stop, square up in stance, and slide back the other way.
Zig-zag the full court, then switch the starting direction.

drills.name: Two-Closeout Contain Rounds
drills.summary: Close out on two shooters, then contain the drive.
steps: Start under the rim with your partner on one wing.
Close out on the partner, then they pass back and move to the other wing.
Close out again; this time they can shoot or drive.
Contain the drive for three dribbles, then switch roles.

drills.name: Live Spin Cutoffs
drills.summary: Cut off a live dribbler who uses spins and counters.
steps: Partner starts at the top of the key with the ball.
They attack with a spin, crossover or hesi in a lane-wide space.
Beat them to the spot and force them to pick up the ball.
Play to a stop, a score, or 5 dribbles, then switch roles.

advanced.summary: Advanced guard conditioning: shuttles, transition rim runs and a late-game circuit with short rest.

drills.name: Fourth-Quarter Shuttle Repeats
drills.summary: Hard shuttles with short rest, like back-to-back possessions.
steps: Set cones at the baseline, free-throw line, half court and far free-throw line.
Sprint to each cone and back to the baseline.
Rest 20 seconds, then go again.
Hit every cone with your hand each time.

drills.name: Rim-Run Transition Repeats
drills.summary: Sprint the floor in transition lanes and finish at the rim.
steps: Start at the baseline with the ball.
Speed-dribble to the far rim and finish a layup.
Grab the ball and sprint back down the sideline lane.
Finish at the near rim, then rest 15 seconds.
Repeat, using your off hand every other trip.

drills.name: Closeout Burnout Rounds
drills.summary: Back-to-back closeouts and slides to keep your stance when tired.
steps: Set four cones around the three-point line.
Sprint from the rim and close out to the first cone.
Slide two steps, then sprint back to the rim.
Go to each cone in order, rest 15 seconds, repeat.

drills.name: Overtime Mini-Game Circuit
drills.summary: A nonstop game-speed circuit of attacks, sprints and free throws.
steps: Attack from the wing with a combo move and finish at the rim.
Sprint to half court and back.
Shoot two free throws right away.
Slide the full lane width and back twice.
Repeat the circuit nonstop and track your free-throw makes.
